title: Defer unqualified precision providers and close M7 C01 research spike
commitMessage: docs: qualify precision provider deferral and close M7 C01

contribution.summary: Complete M7-W01-C01-T2 Q/O/D by an explicit high-precision/interval provider deferral. Reverify RS106 exact oracles, source SHA pins, absence of qualified third-party providers and three mandatory review triggers. Close only C01 as a research spike; leave W01/M7 open, without delivering a precision API or package.
contribution.value: An independent BCL-only gate checks T1 provenance, native/backlog transitions and the not-admitted candidate matrix. Document required future consumer need, pinned source/license/RID/cost and operation-by-operation rounding/oracles with an isolated source-free consumer. No external license/provider is inferred or adopted.
debtChanges: Do not equate completed M7 C01 research with a delivered arbitrary-precision real or certified interval API.
Provider re-entry needs all three triggers: observed consumer gap; exact source/license/RID/cost; independent rounding and source-free consumer qualification.
One bounded rational enclosure is not a general interval theorem and says nothing about measured uncertainty or statistical confidence.
External package/version/rights/semver and OS/RID evidence remain unobserved; no automatic provider or sibling adoption is authorized.
M7-W01 and M7 remain active; C02 tensor research and all later advanced extensions require distinct oracles and admission decisions.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS107 success, prepare M7-W01-C02-T1: bound tensor-shape research with independent 2x2x2 reference, invalid dimensions, size budget and consumer need; no advanced tensor library or external Math/AURA cutover unless separately accepted.

achievements.achievement: Define strict provider admission/deferral criteria including caller need and the three independent future review triggers.
Reverify two retained exact T1 oracles and source SHA receipts, screen unqualified providers and prove no integration was authorized.
Issue explicit defer-with-review-trigger decision, preserving rights, rounding and measurement uncertainty nonclaims.
Qualify Q/O/D precision provider boundary decision and independent local deferral gate without building a new package.
Close the M7 precision and interval research spike through qualified provider deferral, not delivered numerical runtime capabilities.
